subject: Rendering pipeline — world draw order, render states, and frame composition
overview: GTA:SA's renderer is built on RenderWare (RW 3.7). The game renders one frame per CGame::Process tick. The overall draw order is: sky → terrain → buildings → vehicles → peds → particles → water → 2D overlays. All geometry is submitted as RpClump/RpAtomic batches to the RenderWare pipeline, which translates to DirectX 9 draw calls.

render_state_cache.description: RenderWare caches DirectX render state to avoid redundant SetRenderState calls. The cache is a 256-element array of DWORD values at a static RW address (not exposed via a named global). Modifications must go through RwD3D9SetRenderState wrappers.

alpha_pass_system.description: The engine sorts transparent geometry into a secondary bucket and renders it after opaque geometry. The sort key is distance from camera. CAlphaObjectList manages this bucket.

texture_filtering.description: The game sets anisotropic filtering on all mesh textures at start-up based on the graphics settings menu. The max AF level is queried from D3DCAPS9.MaxAnisotropy and clamped to the user's setting.
texture_filtering.default_filter: D3DTEXF_LINEAR (bilinear, the in-game default on 'Medium' detail)

draw_distance_scalars.description: View distance is controlled by two floating-point globals. The level-of-detail cutoff and the far-clip plane both scale from these.

ms_fLODDistMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to all per-model LOD distances
